programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 18-year-old Laetitia Perrais is a trainee hotel waitress who vanishes after an evening shift; every attempt is made to shed light on her disappearance and the efforts eventually pay off.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, The Devil's Plateau. What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending Teknival in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written DIRTY RAPIST. Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On May 17th 2005, a body is discovered in a forest of Sucy-en-Brie; Christophe Belle, 40 years old, a renowned pastry cook.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of a four year old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 18th 2014, in Visé, Belgium, policemen are informed that gunshots had been fired on the street.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself? Clues will help investigators to see in between the subterfuges and lies, leading them to the terrible truth.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin. Inside the house, firefighters find the burned body of Jean-Jacques Le Page.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 9th 1987, the naked body of the young Evelyne Boucher is found near Avignon. An unprecedented investigation begins making headlines.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On May 30th 2015 in Sorinières, Yann Machand reports his wife Céline Marchand missing. Despite a call for evidence and numerous researches, this 39 years old heir, mother of two is nowhere to be found.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Around 11PM the police are called for an assault in a parking lot in the forest of Saint-Lambet-des-Bois.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On January 27th 2014, in Somme-Suippe in the Marne, Sophie Thevenet discovers her husband dead in the garage.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, a 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9th 2007, around 11:30PM, aid arrives on the scene of an accident at the exit of Chateney-en-France.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 5, 2000, two hunters discover a charred body on the banks of the Oise.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9, 2011, the body of a man was found near the Courcelles-le-Comte cemetery (Pas-de-Calais).

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to 16-year-old Karine Schaaff is found abandoned on the side of a road in Moselle; 10 days later her body is found just kilometers away, hidden in a forest.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear; there are many theories surrounding this mysterious case.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest; the police are perplexed by the clues found at the crime scene and the state of the body which is missing both the head and heart.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.desc: In the region that includes the Mediterranean, the Aegean, Mesopotamia and Egypt, the Bronze Age arrived about 3000 BC and lasted nearly 2000 years.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.desc: Trade, and in particular trade in luxury goods, drove the commerce economies of the Bronze Age.

programme.title: Bronze Age
programme.desc: The Bronze Age had the first large urban centers, powerful kingdoms and armies, writing, and trade routes across vast areas. What led to the end of the Bronze Age?

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.desc: About 8,000 BC, in a few select places some people begin to experiment with a new way of harvesting energy. They’re growing their own crops.

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.desc: Columbus has no idea that because of Earth’s geology and geography he won't get to his destination…or how that failure made his voyage one of the most influential.

programme.title: Deep Time History
programme.desc: How do prehistoric forests link to the development of steam engines, and the rise of modern industry?

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: New evidence suggests humans arrived in North America far earlier than previously thought, and that they may have traveled along paths now buried deep beneath the sea.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: The eruption of Mount Vesuvius is renowned for its decimation of Pompeii, but nearby, an equally impressive Roman settlement known as Herculaneum was lost to history.

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: The Vikings were the last barbarians. From the ice fields of the North to the Russian steppe, these fearsome Scandinavian warriors sailed the globe for three centuries spreading their net of trade and pillage. But where are their origins?

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: In this episode of our series, we learn how early Viking society developed, what the sacred rituals really were, and what role women played in Viking religion. Together with archaeologists Tom Christensen, Gunnar Andersson, and expert Marit Vea we will shed light on these dark times in Scandinavia.

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: The Vikings were great explorers and sailors. They exceeded all others in that area. Speedy, lightweight ships carried Nordic warriors all the way from their Scandinavian homes to lands of conquest. How were these ergonomic ships built and what made them so special?

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: The Vikings were fighting machines, they invested in the best weapons money could buy and the finest armor, slashing their way into the history books. They plundered lands from central Asia to North America and defeated the armies of the greatest empires. What was their secret?

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: In Katmai National Park, Alaska a massive population of coastal brown bears gather to eat salmon as they migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: Casey and the crew go out in search of the family of the lost cub from the previous night. They hope that if they find them, the cub will have found them as well.

programme.title: Ancient Yellowstone

programme.title: Ancient Yellowstone

programme.title: Ancient Yellowstone

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.title: Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is enroute to meet with Moya. They eat Noranti's concoction and raiders entomb Rygel in amber.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Everyone reunites on Moya. Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims he saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.title: Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.title: I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.desc: When Moya is raided by Peacekeeper bounty hunters, everyone is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

programme.title: A Prefect Murder
programme.desc: While Moya's crew are resupplying on a xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect.

programme.title: Coup By Clam
programme.desc: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. But if not ingested by the same person, it becomes deadly.

programme.title: Unrealized Reality
programme.desc: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

programme.title: Kansas
programme.desc: Crichton accidentally alters the past, causing his dad to fly on the doomed shuttle 'Challenger'.

programme.title: Terra Firma
programme.desc: Crichton has arrived home. Although the crew relaxes, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

programme.title: Twice Shy
programme.desc: Moya takes on a new passenger, but she is an alien in disguise, intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

programme.title: Mental As Anything
programme.desc: The crew's males undergo training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes, D'Argo learns self control.

programme.title: Bringing Home The Beacon
programme.desc: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon that will allow Moya to camouflage.

programme.title: A Constellation Of Doubt
programme.desc: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a tv documentary.

programme.title: Prayer
programme.desc: Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities'. Aeryn resists torture on a Scarran ship.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.desc: The crew goes after Aeryn on a Scarran controlled station.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.desc: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends peace talks between Scarrans and Peacekeepers with a nuclear bomb.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.desc: Scorpius has betrayed the crew. Now they're all captured. The plan failed so the crew must help Scorpius.

programme.title: Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans travel through a wormhole to Earth, where those flowers grow.

programme.title: Premiere
programme.desc: Astronaut John Crichton is sucked through a wormhole into a distant part of the universe.

programme.title: Exodus From Genesis
programme.desc: A locator beacon on Moya is automatically broadcasting its exact location to Peacekeeper forces in the area.

programme.title: Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.desc: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.

programme.title: Throne For A Loss
programme.desc: Rygel is captured by bounty hunters. He stole a crystal from Moya and she will crash if it isn't returned.

programme.title: PK Tech Girl
programme.desc: The crew finds the Zelbinion battleship. They work to get the shield functional before it's attacked again.

programme.title: Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.desc: The crew visits a planet of happy workers. Rygel's fluids become explosive. Aeryn and Pilot must learn why.

programme.title: I, E.T.
programme.desc: A peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered.

programme.title: That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton and Crais's spirits are captured by Maldis, who thrives on hate. Zhaan takes a dark path to fight.

programme.title: DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew and promises to use it to find their home planets.

programme.title: They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute and gets ejected into open space.

programme.title: Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.desc: John and Aeryn avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole while flying his ship near a high flare sun.

programme.title: The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: Z'han joins her own people, but one of them wants something from her and will do almost anything to take it.

programme.title: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.title: Durka Returns
programme.desc: Moya collides with a Nebari ship. Durka is on board and has been mind cleansed. He now serves the Nebari.

programme.title: A Human Reaction
programme.desc: Moya travels through an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth.

programme.title: Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Moya tries to starburst to prove herself but it goes wrong when she gets split into several dimensions.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: A peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base.

programme.title: The Hidden Memory
programme.desc: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind. Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

programme.title: Bone To Be Wild
programme.desc: The crew find a planetoid that's a paradise occupied by a scientist and a girl. But one is a killer.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Moya's crew say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before trying to save Moya and her baby.

programme.title: Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Headlined by a high-stakes trilogy clash between Antonio Plazibat and longtime rival Nordine Mahieddine. Knockout artist Errol Zimmerman takes on former Australian strongman Alex Simon. Also, two explosive four-man, one-night tournaments in the welterweight and light heavyweight divisions—guaranteeing nonstop drama, finishes, and rising contenders.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 100 features four GLORY world title bouts, four separate four-man one-night tournaments to determine who qualifies for the Last Heavyweight Standing finals, and several key matchups involving some of GLORY’s most popular fighters.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: This event featured world title fight for the inaugural Glory Welterweight Championship of Karapet Karapetyan vs. Marc de Bonte as headliner, and 4 Man Heavyweight Contender Tournament.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol The Bonecrusher Zimmerman versus Bangin Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei The Paratrooper Kharitonov vs. Anderson Braddock Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat HD Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack The Black Warrior Mwekassa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 100 features four GLORY world title bouts, four separate four-man one-night tournaments to determine who qualifies for the Last Heavyweight Standing finals, and several key matchups involving some of GLORY’s most popular fighters.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY heavyweight world champion Mory Kromah (37-3-1, 21 KO) defends his title against Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (19-5, 10 KO), Croatian superstar Antonio Plazibat (23-5, 16 KO) faces Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (49-5, 37 KO) and the GLORY light heavyweight grand prix plays out in full, deciding the next GLORY light heavyweight world champion.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The banquet is finally here. Its the culmination of months of hard work as the winning chefs strive to plate up perfect dishes for the ladies of the Womens Institute, at Londons historic Drapers Hall where pioneers of the WI once gathered.

programme.title: Billy the Kid Versus Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula arrives in the Old West, setting his sights on a young ranch owner. Her fiancé, Billy the Kid, is warned of the vampire’s true nature but struggles to convince others. As Dracula tightens his grip, Billy must act fast to save his bride-to-be before it’s too late.

programme.title: Rustlers on Horseback
programme.desc: The people around the town of Sloan Junction think that George Parradine is just a harmless book salesman, but he heads a gang of crooks planning to rob and pillage on a large scale.

programme.title: The Oil Prince
programme.desc: The Oilprince is a ruthless businessman who sells a bank worthless oil wells that do not exist. When settlers plan to move to Shelly Lake, he replaces their scout to divert them for his own benefit. His scheme is threatened when Winnetou and his blood brother Old Surehand step in to expose the fraud.

programme.title: Amongst Vultures
programme.desc: Old Surehand and Winnetou investigate the murders of a mother and daughter. While the grieving husband blames local Indians, Old Surehand suspects the Vultures, a gang of outlaws who disguise themselves as Indians to conceal their crimes. Together, they set out to expose the real killers.

programme.title: Ride Out for Revenge
programme.desc: When an Indian chief is murdered in a hateful town, a sympathizing ex marshal tries to stop the Indians from attacking for revenge.

programme.title: Wyatt Earp S01E29-32
programme.desc: In one of television's first adult Westerns, the famous marshal puts his life on the line to maintain order, first in Dodge City, Kan., then in Tombstone, Ariz.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble. Will they ever fulfil their dreams?

programme.title: The Executioner of God
programme.desc: A former gunman turned priest seeks vengeance on three bandits who are masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

programme.title: The Avenging Angel
programme.desc: Miles Utley, a skilled Mormon commando and bodyguard, is forced to go rogue while investigating a deadly scandal of assassination and land speculation. As danger mounts, he must confront his beliefs and decide where his true loyalties lie in a world of betrayal and faith.

programme.title: California Passage
programme.desc: Cowboy Movie - A series of reversals bring two desperate people together. When a saloon owner is framed by his partner for a stagecoach robbery, he fights to secure an acquittal.

programme.title: Killer Caliber 32
programme.desc: Hired gun Silver kills a masked gang’s seven members one by one, using silver bullets and his own code of justice. Between poker games and saloon girls, his mission leads to the dramatic unmasking of the gang’s ruthless leader. Silver’s style and honor make him a deadly force in this action-packed tale.

programme.title: Heads or Tails
programme.desc: Shanda is charged with the murder of the banker, Burton and to save her from being lynched, the sheriff sends her off to Phoenix. During the trip the two deputies to whom she’s been entrusted rape and leave her in the desert, certain that she’s dead. The girl is found by Black Talisman, an outlaw, who takes her to his hideout, nurses her back to health and after hearing her story, determines to avenge her and clear her name.

programme.title: Robbery Under Arms
programme.desc: Two brothers join their father in Captain Starlight's bush ranger gang in 19th Century Australia.

programme.title: Cattle Queen of Montana
programme.desc: Sierra Nevada Jones must fight a villainous rancher to regain the land that is rightfully hers.

programme.title: Taste of Killing
programme.desc: Dubious Bounty Killer Hank Fellows tracks bank stage coaches to observe them being robbed.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

programme.title: Bury Me Not
programme.desc: Two women hide the surprising truth as a sheriff investigates a murder.

programme.title: Boot Hill
programme.desc: Victims of oppressive town boss Honey are offered help by an unusual alliance of gunmen and circus performers.

programme.title: Bandidos
programme.desc: Renowned gunman Richard Martin is traveling on a train, held up by Billy Kane, a former student of Martin's. Kane spares Martin, but only after shooting his hands. Years later, Martin meets an escaped convict, wrongly convicted for the train robbery. Martin trains his new student and both men seek out Billy Kane.

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican
programme.desc: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

programme.title: Singing Guns
programme.desc: Notorious stagecoach robber Rhiannon is unintentionally appointed as deputy when he saves the sheriff's life and must wear two hats between his new job that he enjoys and his old occupation that he misses.

programme.title: The Cariboo Trail
programme.desc: Montanans Jim Redfern and Mike Evans head into Canada's British Columbia via the Cariboo Trail intent to raise cattle and dig for gold but find trouble instead.

programme.title: His Name Was Sam Walbash, But They Call Him Amen
programme.desc: A cruel and ruthless bandit kills a tavern owner who had ratted him out to the authorities.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Gang of sadistic cowboys let nothing stand in their way in their search for gold.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
programme.desc: Sartana, a bounty hunter and gunfighter, witnesses a gold robbery and arrives in a suspicious town run by Samuel Spencer. Hired to protect the next shipment, Sartana fends off numerous incompetent villains, surviving their attempts on his life. Meanwhile, his nemesis, Sabbath—known for his white coat and parasol—arrives in town. With tensions rising, Sartana and Sabbath are headed for a final showdown to settle the score.

programme.title: Four Fast Guns
programme.desc: A gunslinger rides into Purgatory, claiming to be the town tamer they hired—though he killed the real one. For $500, payable to a widow of his victim, he takes on the town's wheelchair-bound crime boss. The outlaw fights to free the town while facing three hired killers sent to eliminate him, testing his resolve and his skill as lawman-for-hire.

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

programme.title: Thunder at the Border
programme.desc: Winnetou and his sister Nscho-chi flee the murderous Silers gang and find refuge with Old Firehand and his trappers. In the border town of Miramonte, an old love and family secret are revealed, but the reunion is threatened when the Silers gang prepares an attack. Winnetou and Old Firehand help defend the town.

programme.title: Mackenzie's Raiders EP25-28
programme.desc: Colonel Mackenzie, commander of the 4th Cavalry Regiment at Fort Clark near Brackettville in Kinney County in southwest Texas during the 1870s, receives secret orders from President Ulysses S. Grant and Secretary of War William W. Belknap to stop bandits from crossing the Rio Grande into the United States, or from returning to Mexico.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: In 1854, Jeb Stuart, George Custer and other graduates from West Point are posted to Kansas to help pacify the territory before railroad construction to Santa Fe can resume.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: A disgraced Confederate colonel deserts and escapes into the Everglades, joining four other Southern deserters. Surrounded by hostile Seminoles, the group must navigate the treacherous swamp while confronting both nature and their inner demons in a tense fight for survival.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak. Our black-clad hero soon has a price on his head and must try to proof his innocence with the help of his shabby friend Buddy Ben.

programme.title: My Gun is the Law
programme.desc: In San Felipe, bandits target gold meant for the railroad - until a decoy chest thwarts them. When newcomers arrive, a masked gunman begins sabotaging the outlaws. But the real mastermind may be the town’s respected leader, hiding treachery behind wealth and charm.

programme.title: Lightning Jack
programme.desc: Lightning Jack Kane is an Australian outlaw in the wild west. During a bungled bank robbery he picks up mute Ben Doyle as a hostage. The two become good friends, with Jack teaching Ben how to rob banks, while they plan Jack's last heist.

programme.title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil
programme.desc: Scotty is hired to eliminate a gang of Mexican bandits led by El Condor. He cleverly earns their trust to trap them—but as he bonds with El Condor, a true friendship and mutual respect begin to challenge his mission.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: What could be worse for two cavalry officers than to battle with native tribes? To battle each other for the same woman.

programme.title: Four Gunmen of the Holy Trinity
programme.desc: Arms trafficking with the Indians on the one hand and acquiring documents concerning the ownership of a goldmine on the other are the principal interests of Quin and Gomez, the highly suspicious guests at Papa Martinez' inn.

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: A ranch boy is gifted with a colt, grows to love him but the colt escapes, with tragic results.

programme.title: Dead Men Don't Count
programme.desc: Two gunmen ride into a town with a plan to collect a large unearned bounty but are caught up in the local war for land caused by the impending arrival of the railroad.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.desc: Summertime is all about being outdoors and fun host Jessica McGovern whips up some sweet treats that are perfect for a summer pool party.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Boo! Did that scare you? If so, then you better steer clear of this super spooky Holiday Eatz Halloween episode with chef-host Kimberly Lallouz! But that would be too bad, because then you'd miss a menu featuring fun but grown-up Halloween eats like Jack O'Lantern Curry, served with Irish-inspired spiced Pumpkin Barmbrack bread. Next, you'd miss a ghostly surprise with her pan seared Black Cod buried in a pile of carrot-chip 'Autumn Leaves' and drizzled with mango sauce made with... ghost peppers! Her 'Fet Ghede' (Haitian Day of the Dead) inspired beef rib follows... with a rib bone connected to... melting tender beef braised in Haiti's signature Epis spice and crunched-up with yummy pumpkin seeds. For a sweet ending, it's a 'Bag of Candy'... or in this case, homemade profiterole stuffed with mascarpone and all of your favourite candies! See, that wasn't so scary, was it? Mwahahahaha!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh gets the show on the road with her Italian- inspired Fennel Orange Salad. Seared sushi-grade tuna rests on top of a crunchy, zesty, tangy fennel and orange salad with a honey-vinegar dressing to sweeten it up! Micah Trainor's revamp? Five Spice Duck a L'Orange with a sugary caramelized orange sauce and duck fat fried potatoes - is it French? Chinese? Who knows, but it's delicious! Next, Poppy Sandler pulls off a vegetarian variation, with a Roasted Veggie Bouillabaisse, complete with musky morels, umami-packed kombu, and tender asparagus. Missy Hui finishes up with her Orange Licorice Panna Cotta - aromatic orange blossom honey and licorice-like fennel pollen make the dish a decadent denouement to this episode of Up the Dish!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.desc: A former bank in Crewe is sold at auction, but will it prove a nice little earner for its new owner? In Cumbria a flood damaged home is bought to benefit the community, and in London a developer has grand plans for a two bedroom flat in Tooting.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin is on the North Wales coast, Dion is in Derby and Lucys in Maidstone, Kent. The developers are considering adding bedrooms and putting in new bathrooms and kitchens, but will splashing the cash net them more money?

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A super dad helps his daughter out buying and transforming a maisonette for her to live in, and in Derby two friends hope to create smart accommodation for seven students. In Rainham in Kent a developer has ambitious plans to smarten up a shop.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A film extra buys a flat to refurbish in Folkestone in Kent, while another developer has ambitious plans for a former council depot in Milton in Stoke on Trent and two footballing friends take on a detached 1930s house in Norbury in London.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Two brothers buy a bungalow for their mother in Staffordshire and elsewhere property developers buy a huge barn in Upwell in Norfolk and a large three bedroom flat in Londons Tooting.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: There's a plan to transform a Victorian terrace in York into a home, while developers in Rainham, Kent, want to build flats on land sandwiched between two busy roads and investors hope to restore a flood damaged Cumbrian property.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A damp and dingy basement flat in Kilburn with space for an extension, a former post office in Gedney Dyke in Lincolnshire and a bungalow in Cornwalls Liskeard are sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Hostiles
programme.desc: Lännenelokuva kertoo tarinan verivihollisista, jotka joutuvat pakosta sietämään toisiaan.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: Jenny Farrell on päättänyt mennä naimisiin, mutta perinteisen ja tiukkapipoisen perheen yllätykseksi Jennyn kihlattu onkin nainen. Järkyttynyt Farrellin perhe yrittää totutella ajatukseen uudesta miniästä.

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom on viehättävä mutta piinallisen ujo mies, joka vuosien yksinäisyyden jälkeen on saanut Internetissä ystävän, Biancan. Niinpä Lars tuo Biancan kotiin ja esittelee hänet veljelleen Gusille ja tämän vaimolle Karinille.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Perustuu tositarinaan neljästä ulkopuolisesta, jotka näkivät sen, minkä isot pankit, media ja valtionhallinto kielsivät: maailmantalouden romahtamisen. Rohkea sijoittaminen johtaa heidät pankkialan pimeälle puolelle, jossa kaikki on kyseenalaistettava.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Zane, tähtitieteilijä, löytää avaruusolentoja, mutta avaruusolennoilla on tappava salaisuus ja he tekevät kaikkensa estääkseen Zanea saamasta sitä selville.

programme.title: A Cry In The Dark
programme.desc: Tässä mukaansatempaavassa draamassa eletään vuotta 1980, ja Chamberlainin perhe suuntaa telttaretkelle Australian suosituimman turistinähtävyyden, Ayers Rockin, läheisyyteen erämaahan – matka, joka muuttaa heidän elämänsä ikuisesti. Pääosissa Meryl Streep ja Sam Neill!

programme.title: Murha vailla syyllistä
programme.desc: Vuonna 1924 mediamoguli William Randolph Hearst kokosi joitain maailman tunnetuimmista persoonallisuuksista jahtinsa matkalle, joka johti vielä ratkaisemattomaan, hiljaiseen murhaan.

programme.title: Paluu Yorkshireen
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison (Jim Broadbent) saa tietää, että hänellä on syöpä ja vain muutama viikko aikaa elää. Hänen vanhin poikansa Blake (Oscar-voittaja* Colin Firth) muuttaa Yorkshireen äitinsä luokse, kylään jossa hän syntyi. Kun Arthurin tila heikkenee, Blake puntaroi suhdettaan isäänsä.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho on kansainvälinen agentti, joka on ollut mukana vaikka missä: takaa-ajoissa, räjähdyksissä, putoamisissa. Ne eivät kuitenkaan ole mitään verrattuna hänenseuraavaan tehtäväänsä: hänen pitää hoitaa tyttöystävänsä kolmea kakaraa!

programme.title: You're Not You
programme.desc: Kaksinkertainen Oscar-voittaja Hillary Swank on menestynyt konserttipianisti Kate, jossa todetaan parantumaton sairaus ALS. Hänen perheensä järjestää hänelle parasta mahdollista hoitoa, mutta Kate itse antautuu täysin epäpätevän Becin hoiviin.

programme.title: Let me in
programme.desc: Nuori Owen tapaa merkillisen tytön. Tyttö on kalpea ja laiha, mutta kuitenkin kaunis. Tyttö antaa Owenille voimaa nousta kiusaajiaan vastaan, mutta hän ei ole kuten muut. Hän ei siedä aurinkoa eikä syö, ja voidakseen tulla sisälle hänet on ensin kutsuttava sisään.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Nuorenparin täytyy paeta lähetyssaarnaaja-asemaltaan Kalaharin autiomaassa, kun sotilaallinen äärijärjestö uhkaa heitä. Mutta kun heidän koneensa tippuu villieläinten suojelualueelle, heidän täytyy taistella henkensä edestä.

programme.title: A Score to Settle
programme.desc: Frank on lusinut vankilassa 22 vuotta - syyttömänä. Vapauduttuaan hän aikoo etsiä käsiinsä kaikki ne ihmiset, jotka pettivät hänet ja joiden takia hän joutui linnaan.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Tyler Hawkins elää rauhatonta elämää ja haluaa olla erilainen. Rakkaus ei kuulu hänen tärkeimpiin toiveisiinsa, kunnes hän tapaa Allyn. Allyn rohkeus ja spontaanius saavat Tylerin rentoutumaan ja löytämään oman onnensa ja elämän tarkoituksen.

programme.title: Autumn in New York
programme.desc: Will Keane on viittäkymppiä lähestyvä menestyvä newyorkilainen ravintoloitsija ja parantumaton naistenmies. Mies purjehtii suhteesta toiseen - kunnes hän kohtaa nuoren Charlotten. Vielä kokematon Charlotte on sulaa vahaa maailmanmiehen käsittelyssä, mutta romanssi saa tylyn lopun.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton on nuori ja komea mutta rahaton tennisvalmentaja, joka sotkeutuu rikkaan perheen kuvioihin ryhdyttyään perheen tyttären valmentajaksi. Rakkaussuhteet kahden eri naisen kanssa pakottavat hänet julmaan rikokseen. Intohimoa, kiusauksia ja mielettömyyttä yläluokan Lontoossa.

programme.title: Talo jossa kello tikittää
programme.desc: Talo jossa kello tikittää kertoo taianomaisen tarinan 10-vuotiaasta Lewisistä, joka muuttaa enonsa luokse vanhaan, narisevaan taloon, jonka uumenissa tikittää mystisesti.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Newyorkilainen työhullu kustannustoimittaja Jackie seuraa poikaansa Los Angelesiin. Poika haluaa jättää opiskelut sikseen ja elää unelmaansa Kaliforniassa, missä myös äidillä on pian edessään tyrskyjä ja kuohuja.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Arvottomat
programme.desc: Arvottomat on ajaton kuvaus siitä kuinka Pikkurikollinen Manne, maalaispoika Harri ja kaunis Veera ajavat Volgalla läpi suomalaismaisemien, poliisien ja gangsterien roikkuessa herkeämättä kintereillä.

programme.title: Naiset - The Women
programme.desc: He käyttävät omaisuuksia design-vaatteisiin. Heillä on vakiopaikat kauneussalongeissa ja he pääsevät eturiviin trendikkäissä muotinäytöksissä. Lisäksi heillä on täydellinen lääke särkyneeseen sydämeen: kosto!

programme.title: 7 Days In Entebbe
programme.desc: Todellisten tapahtumien inspiroima 7 Days in Entebbe kertoo lentokoneen kaappauksesta Air Francen lennolla 139 Tel Avivista Pariisiin vuonna 1976 ja sitä seuranneesta uskaliaasta pelastusoperaatiosta.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: Nuoripari matkustaa syrjäiselle mökille selvittelemään suhdettaan. Sitten mökille ilmestyy yllätysvieras; tuntematon mies pahat mielessä. Matkasta tulee oikea painajainen, ja nuoret joutuvat kamppailemaan hengestään.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Luc Bessonin toimintaelokuvan pääosassa upea Zoe Saldana (Avatar) pukeutuu koston mustaan raivatessaan tieltään vanhempiensa tappajat.COLOMBIANA on toiminnantäyteinen tarina nuoresta tytöstä, joka joutuu raakuuksien ja koston maailmaan.

programme.title: A Cure for Wellness
programme.desc: Ringin visionäärisen ohjaajan psykologinen trilleri yritysjohtajasta, jonka mielenterveys joutuu koetukselle, kun hänelle valkenevat syrjäisen piilopaikan kauhistuttavat salaisuudet.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Stronger
programme.desc: Stronger on inspiroiva tositarina Jeff Baumanista, tavallisesta 27-vuotiaasta miehestä, josta tuli toivon symboli vuoden 2013 Bostonin maratonin pommi-iskun jälkeen.

programme.title: Because I Said So
programme.desc: Daphne Wilder on kolmen tyttären ylpeä äiti: Millyn, Maggien ja Maen. Hänen rakkautensa lapsiaan kohtaan ei tunne rajoja. Valitettavasti hänen nuorin tyttärensä valitsee aina vääriä miehiä, joten Daphne päättää toimia estääkseen Millyä toistamasta menneisyyden virheitä.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: Ruotsalainen Avioliitto
programme.desc: Erland on töissä pikkupaikkakunnan paperitehtaassa parhaan ystävänsä Sven-Erikin kanssa. Vapaa-aikana hän pitää seurakunnan avioliittokoulua yhdessä vaimonsa Mayn kanssa. Eräissä juhlissa Erland rakastuu tulisesti Sven-Erikin vaimoon Kariniin.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: Blue Jasmine
programme.desc: Jasmine (Cate Blanchett, Benjamin Buttonin uskomaton elämä, 2008, Elisabet Kultainen aikakausi, 2007) pintaliitää New Yorkin runsaudensarvessa ei ole mitään, mitä luottokortilla ei saisi.

programme.title: Street Wise, Part 2
programme.desc: An investigation leads Hunter to the killer of a fellow officer while McCall weighs the decision to marry.

programme.title: Deadly Encounters, Part 1
programme.desc: Hunter teams with two Metro officers to locate the missing profits of a murdered black-marketeer.

programme.title: Deadly Encounters, Part 2
programme.desc: Hunter teams with two Metro officers to locate the missing profits of a murdered black-marketeer.

programme.title: Where Echoes End
programme.desc: Hunter attempts to clear the name of a fellow detective accused of a lucrative scheme.

programme.title: Kill Zone
programme.desc: Hunter and Molenski investigate a series of rape/murders that revive disturbing memories for Molenski.

programme.title: The Incident
programme.desc: Hunter and Molenski battle a neighborhood watch group whose members are taking the law into their own hands.

programme.title: A Snitch'll Break Your Heart
programme.desc: Molenski battles to protect the identity of an informant as Hunter investigates a boy's death.

programme.title: Oh, The Shark Bites!

programme.title: The Usual Suspects

programme.title: This Is My Gun
programme.desc: While investigating a series of art thefts, Molenski's gun is stolen and used in a fatal robbery.

programme.title: La Familia
programme.desc: When a friend of Hunter's is released from prison, he struggles to keep his son from continuing gang activity.

programme.title: Acapulco Holiday
programme.desc: Hunter clashes with an opportunistic lawyer when he arrests the wrong suspect.

programme.title: Fatal Obsession, Part 1
programme.desc: A former girlfriend complicates Hunter's investigation of a string of campus murders.

programme.title: Fatal Obsession, Part 2
programme.desc: A former girlfriend complicates Hunter's investigation of a string of campus murders.

programme.title: Under Suspicion
programme.desc: Hunter unwittingly helps a businessman find and kill a fleeing executive.

programme.title: The Reporter
programme.desc: Novak's old friend comes to Los Angeles to do a story on police work, but impedes an investigation.

programme.title: Room Service
programme.desc: Old passions and jealousies flare when Hunter is forced to work with Chris Novak's ex-husband.

programme.title: Shadows Of The Past
programme.desc: When Chris Novak's estranged father returns to her life, it's not to rekindle their relationship, but to kill.

programme.title: The Grab
programme.desc: Chris' daughter is kidnapped to prevent her father from providing Hunter and Chris with vital information.

programme.title: All That Glitters
programme.desc: Hunter searches for the killer of several people while Novak is concerned with the arrest of a teenaged mugger

programme.title: Cries Of Silence
programme.desc: As Hunter investigates the murder of a foreign dignitary's assistant, Novak searches for a runaway teenager.

programme.title: Ex Marks The Spot
programme.desc: A series of cleaning store robberies exposes the chain's owner as the decoy for a money laundering conspiracy.

programme.title: Little Man With A Big Reputation
programme.desc: Devane becomes entangled in the life of an ex-convict who disappears shortly before his wedding.

programme.title: The Return Of Hunter: Everyone Walks In L.A.
programme.desc: Rick Hunter's back. He's considering marrying his girlfriend. But before he could, she is murdered.

programme.title: Hunter
programme.desc: Son of a mobster, Detective Sergeant Rick Hunter and Sergeant Dee Dee McCall team up to catch a serial killer.

programme.title: Hard Contract
programme.desc: McCall's ex-partner has gone bad. In an attempt to save him from prison, McCall and Hunter try to stop him.

programme.title: The Hot Grounder
programme.desc: After the Commissioner's wife is murdered, Hunter and McCall piece together the clues to find the true killer.

programme.title: A Long Way From L.A.
programme.desc: A meek pick-pocket is accused of beating a woman. Hunter and McCall, unconvinced, must find the true culprit.

programme.title: Legacy
programme.desc: Hunter uses a mobster's girlfriend as bait after she overhears an argument between him and his father.

programme.title: Flight On A Dead Pigeon
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall help a girl who claims her uncle has died and all of his pigeons have been stolen.

programme.title: Pen Pals
programme.desc: A drug dealer is killed by a thief who stole Hunter's backup gun. McCall must clear Hunter's name.

programme.title: Dead Or Alive
programme.desc: A bounty hunter tracking two bank robbers crosses paths with Hunter and McCall.

programme.title: High Bleacher Man
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall must protect a sleazy criminal who has been given immunity for fingering a top criminal.

programme.title: The Shooter
programme.desc: A motorcycle cop is killed by a man on a nighthawk. The killer motivated by a dispute over a game at a bar.

programme.title: The Garbage Man
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall must track down a killer who has been shooting parolees.

programme.title: The Avenging Angel
programme.desc: A mentally disturbed surveillance expert attempts to help Hunter by killing a suspect and a witness.

programme.title: The Snow Queen, Part 1
programme.desc: A cocaine dealer being escorted by an obnoxious detective escapes. Hunter and the detective pursue her.

programme.title: The Snow Queen, Part 2
programme.desc: The pursuit of the cocaine dealer continues and the plot thickens as Hunter and McCall's cases collide.

programme.title: The Beach Boy
programme.desc: The Beach Boy arrives in LA and begins to kill drug dealers. Hunter and McCall must figure out his next move.

programme.title: Guilty
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall pursue a convicted murderer who is free and has vowed to kill the jurors who convicted him.

programme.title: The Last Kill
programme.desc: A contract killer makes hits throughout the city in order to ingratiate himself with a criminal kingpin.

programme.title: Fire Man
programme.desc: Someone has been setting fires all over the city to empty warehouse, and Hunter and McCall are on the case.

programme.title: Sniper
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall go after a sniper who is killing blondes that remind him of his wife who jilted him.

programme.title: Case X
programme.desc: McCall goes undercover to help Hunter investigate the deaths of two models involved in pornographic films.

programme.title: Night Of The Dragons
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate a Chinese gang leader being pursued by a police officer with a personal interest

programme.title: The Biggest Man In Town
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall go undercover at an exclusive resort to find a blackmailer's killer.

programme.title: Rich Girl
programme.desc: A millionaire is nearly killed, his wife the prime suspect, until she's murdered.

programme.title: Killer In The Halloween Mask
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall witness a string of murders when they're assigned as technical advisers for a tv show.

programme.title: Rape And Revenge, Part 1
programme.desc: When McCall is raped by a South American diplomat immune from prosecution, Hunter follows him to his homeland.

programme.title: Rape And Revenge, Part 2
programme.desc: Against departmental orders, Hunter goes to South America to stalk a diplomat who raped McCall.

programme.title: Million Dollar Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall pursue a security guard turned thief as he searches for the money he stole and lost.

programme.title: The Big Fall
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall realize they're attracted to each other as they protect an endangered witness.

programme.title: Waiting For Mr. Wrong
programme.desc: Hunter becomes involved with a beautiful model he suspects of complicity in a jewelry robbery.

programme.title: Think Blue
programme.desc: Hunter helps a policeman who is framed for the murder of his wife.

programme.title: Blow-Up
programme.desc: Hunter pursues a package bomber whose ruthless methods are being used to kill the participants in his trial.

programme.title: War Zone
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall work to stop a brigade of suburban mercenaries plotting to break a drug dealer out of prison

programme.title: Burned
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall are given 72 hours to find an attorney who falsified his death.

programme.title: Scrap Metal
programme.desc: When a dying contract killer confesses he was paid to kill Hunter's father, Hunter pursues the true murderer.

programme.title: Fagin 1986
programme.desc: A teenager's death leads Hunter and McCall to a Fagin who commands a group of barrio boys to commit crimes.

programme.title: 62 Hrs. Of Terror
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate a student terror group in the car bombing of a Middle-Eastern consulate member.

programme.title: Death Machine
programme.desc: Hunter investigates a theft turned murder when a robbery victim hires a detective to retrieve stolen jewels.

programme.title: The Setup
programme.desc: Wrongly suspended from the force for beating a suspect, Hunter pursues the gangster who had him discredited.

programme.title: The Beautiful And The Dead, Part 1
programme.desc: When a dead girl disappears from Hunter's living room, he and McCall follow a trail of intrigue and murder.

programme.title: The Beautiful And The Dead, Part 2
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall's investigation into adultery and homicide pits them against a group of Russian spies.
