programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - One Final Challenge
programme.desc: It’s D-Day. After eight grueling weeks of competition, one very talented rookie will stand atop the podium and take the crown and a $20,000 prize and a dream contract with Team Honda Racing.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - Dirt Vs Road

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - Queen of the Dirt
programme.desc: We finally get to see the rookies hit the dirt track for the first time, and the game changes. Who will take top points and announce themselves as the one to beat, and who will crumble under the pressure?

programme.desc: After a break of dawn beach launch off the tip of 90 Mile Beach, the team punch north to the legendary Three Kings Islands, home to dozens of record calibre fish, and in the process, bag a couple of new records for themselves.

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2 - The Rock
programme.desc: The Spearo team are in the deep South this week, departing Bluff for a couple of days diving the pristine waters of Stewart Island, but will the brief weather window allow them to make the notorious steam all the way to remote Solander Island?

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - Calmwaters Fly Fishing (Ontario)
programme.desc: Bill Spicer explores the rivers of southern Ontario with several guides to catch brown and rainbow trout.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - Big Horn Angler Fly Shop (Montana)
programme.desc: Mark Melnyk gets the opportunity to take a drift boat trip down the famed Big Horn River in Montana searching for trout on a fly.

programme.title: Gold Fever S1 - Daylight and Gold
programme.desc: It's summer time in Alaska so Tom and Kia are making the most of the twenty-four hours of daylight.

programme.desc: It’s a big year for the Cripple River mining camp in Nome Alaska. The participants are finding some of the biggest gold in recent history.

programme.title: Dropped S5 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Using up the last of their energy, the Keefer brothers make their way down stream in search of their next supply cache. The tide turns as they finally make their way out of the open tundra and into the heart of moose country.

Visiting farms to mystical islands, to top kitchens in Manila, this is the ‘never-before-told’ tale of cacao in the Philippine islands.

Liesel embarks on a mission to explore the street food of the city. But this region is usually overshadowed by it’s more famous neighboring cities, Florence and Venice. To understand the food of this region, Liesel explores the quaint sea-side town of Rimini and the hugely impressive Bologna. It's a tale of discovering local foodie passion that allows Liesel to hunt for truffles and try her hand in making her own gelato, a the world’s only Gelato University!

programme.title: Growing Up and Other Lies
programme.desc: Vuosia taiteilijana New Yorkissa riutunut Jake aikoo palata kotiin Ohioon. Viimeisenä päivänään kaupungissa hän kutsuu kolme vanhinta ystäväänsä mukaan nostalgiselle kävelyretkelle Manhattanin päästä päähän. Yritys palata huolettomaan nuoruuteen ei suju ihan toiveiden mukaisesti.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Rakkaustarina feminiinisyydestä, maskuliinisuudesta ja 68 000 dollarin varkaudesta. Chip on simppeli kaveri ja upea tyttöystävä nimeltä Liza. Liza tosin hankkii heidän elantonsa namusedältään, mutta toisaalta jokaisessa parisuhteessa on omat erikoisuutensa.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: Neljä Vietnamin sodan vankileiriltä selvinnyttä veteraania päättää suorittaa viimeisen pakonsa - vanhainkodista. Pakosuunnitelman työstäminen seniilissä porukassa tuo kuitenkin omat haasteensa.

programme.title: Hamekyttä - Pojasta Polvi Paranee
programme.desc: Todistettuaan murhan FBI-agentti Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) ja hänen poikapuolensa (Brandon T. Jackson) joutuvat vetämään valeasut niskaansa ja ryhtymään tutkimuksiin...

programme.title: Alvin Ja Pikkuoravat 3
programme.desc: Lomailevat pikkuoravat ja tyttötrio muuttavat luksusristeilijän omaksi leikkikentäkseen kunnes he haaksirikkoutuvat syrjäiselle saarelle.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: The Funeral Party
programme.desc: Felix Bush haluaa suunnitella omat hautajaisensa ja pyytää apuja järjestelyihin paikalliselta hautausurakoitsijalta Frank Quinnilta. Paikalla tulee olla jokaisen, jolla on kerrottavanaan tarina hänestä. Tärkeintä on, että riennoissa on mukana myös päivänsankari itse – elävänä.

programme.title: Eagle vs Shark
programme.desc: Lily on ujo pikaruokaravintolan tarjoilija, joka kirjoittaa kappaleita, kun kukaan ei kuule. Hän on rakastunut pelikaupassa työskentelevään Jarrodiin.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai on hurmaava taiteentuntija ja nautiskelija, jolla on kalliit elämäntavat. Hän ryhtyy yhdessä brittiläisen MI5-tiedustelupalvelunkanssa etsimään varastettua maalausta.

programme.title: Middle School: The Worst Years Of My Life
programme.desc: Rafe Khatchadorianilla on vaikeasti lausuttava sukunimi, valtavan vilkas mielikuvitus... ja ongelmia auktoriteettien kanssa. Rafe ei ole mikään vallankumouksellinen anarkisti, mutta hän on kuitenkin aloittamassa koulunkäyntiä jo järjestyksessä kolmannella yläasteellaan.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad elää mukavaa elämää Sacramenton esikaupungissa mukavan vaimonsa ja poikansa kanssa. Reissulla vanhaan opiskelukaupunkiinsa, Bostoniin, Brad ei malta olla vertaamatta elämäänsä opiskelukavereihinsa.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Ben elää turvallisen tavallista keski-ikäisen elämää, johon kuuluu vaimo, talo ja haave omasta lapsesta. Eräänä päivänä oven taakse ilmestyy Andrew, vanha kaveri opiskeluajoilta, jonka taiteilijaelämä on kulkenut aivan toista rataa.

programme.title: Colossal
programme.desc: Kun jättiläisolennon kuullaan tuhoavan Soulia, nainen Yhdysvalloissa tajuaa liittyvänsä jollain tavalla ilmiöön. Hän kamppailee ymmärtääkseen, miksi hänen vähäpätöisellä olemassaolollaan on niin suuri vaikutus koko maailmaan.

programme.title: Madness in the Method
programme.desc: Jason Mewes ei halua olla vain Jay and Silent Bobin Jay. Hän ottaa avukseen elokuvantekijä Kevin Smithin jäljittääkseen kirjan, joka voisi tehdä hänestä vakavan ja kunnioitetun näyttelijän. Sitä hän ei kuitenkaan tajua ottaa huomioon...

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Kun lähetti toimittaa vahingossa kätkettyjä kokaiinitiiliä sisältävän paketin väärään osoitteeseen, hän käynnistää tapahtumasarjan...

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva Mad Money seuraa kolmea erilaista naista, jotka ovat töissä Yhdysvaltain keskuspankissa. He muodostavat tuhoon tuomitun liiton varastaakseen pankista rahaa.

programme.title: Results
programme.desc: PT-valmentajat (Cobie Smulders ja Guy Pearce) saavat tässä fiksussa ja hauskassa rakkautta ja ruumiinkuntoa käsittelevässä komediassa tehtäväkseen saada uusrikas ja hyvin motivoitumaton asiakas (Kevin Corrigan) kuntoon.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad elää mukavaa elämää Sacramenton esikaupungissa mukavan vaimonsa ja poikansa kanssa. Reissulla vanhaan opiskelukaupunkiinsa, Bostoniin, Brad ei malta olla vertaamatta elämäänsä opiskelukavereihinsa.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: Danielin ja Robertin isän kuolema saattaa toraisan perheen yhteen suremaan vainajaa. Kun hautajaisiin ilmestyvä mies uhkaa paljastaa vainajan järkyttävän salaisuuden ellei saa rahaa, on veljesten keksittävä jotain päästäkseen kiristäjästä eroon.

programme.title: Hamekyttä - Pojasta Polvi Paranee
programme.desc: Todistettuaan murhan FBI-agentti Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) ja hänen poikapuolensa (Brandon T. Jackson) joutuvat vetämään valeasut niskaansa ja ryhtymään tutkimuksiin...

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Tarina keskittyy neljään ei-niin-nuoreen orpoon: yhden heistä on kasvattanut Louvren kuraattori; toinen on pakolainen meksikolaisesta vapaapainista; kolmas äskettäinen hänen lentokoneessaan olleiden käärmeiden uhri; ja neljäs normaali asukas mutantti X -yhteisöstä.

programme.title: Break Point
programme.desc: Darren on rahapulassa ja Jimmy haluaa tehdä paluun tennismaailman huipulle. Siispä he päättävät lyöttäytyä yhteen, perustaa uudelleen nuoruutensa nelinpeliparin ja pyrkiä Grand Slam -turnaukseen karsintojen kautta.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Vuosi on 1985. Pastellivärien, puutelihiusten ja otsanauhojen aikakautena nuori Janey uneksii tanssijan urasta. Koulua hän on ehtinyt vaihtaa jo 11 kertaa, ja hän tietää että ne eivät muutu miksikään.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Lowlife
programme.desc: Kun helppo elinvarkauskeikka menee pieleen, kohtalon oikku yhdistää kolme yhteiskunnan unohtamaa hylkiötä: Monstruon, meksikolaisen painijan, joka toimii rikospomon turvamiehenä.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Rakkaustarina feminiinisyydestä, maskuliinisuudesta ja 68 000 dollarin varkaudesta. Chip on simppeli kaveri ja upea tyttöystävä nimeltä Liza. Liza tosin hankkii heidän elantonsa namusedältään, mutta toisaalta jokaisessa parisuhteessa on omat erikoisuutensa.

programme.title: Blue Iguana
programme.desc: Kaksi entistä vankia on ehdonalaisessa vapaudessa ja tekee umpikujaan johtavia töitä newyorkilaisessa ruokalassa, kunnes heihin ottaa yhteyttä nörtti englantilainen asianajaja ja värvää heidät juoneen, jonka tarkoituksena on varastaa erittäin arvokas timantti.

programme.title: Fat Kid Rules The World
programme.desc: Troy Billings on seitsemäntoista, ylipainoinen ja itsetuhoinen. Juuri kun hän aikoo hypätä bussin eteen, hänet pelastaakin Marcus, lukion kesken jättänyt hurmaava katumuusikko.

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino on epäonnistunut kirjailija, josta tuli tiskaaja. Nyt hänet tunnetaan ex-vaimon pitämästä blogista “Miksi olet paska”, josta on tullut suuri hitti. Sitten Leo tapaa Coletten, unelmiensa naisen… päivänä, jona Colette on menossa naimisiin täydellisen miehen kanssa.

programme.desc: Lomailevat pikkuoravat ja tyttötrio muuttavat luksusristeilijän omaksi leikkikentäkseen kunnes he haaksirikkoutuvat syrjäiselle saarelle.

programme.title: Majava
programme.desc: Majavasta voi olla apua sinullekin! Walter Blackin huumori on yhtä mustaa kuin hänen sukunimensä. Töissä menee huonosti, vaimo on saanut tarpeekseen ja poika vihaa isäänsä.

programme.title: Peace, Love And Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Komedia menestyksekkäästä newyorkilaisesta asianajajasta (Catherine Keener), joka tuo mukanaan kaksi vilkasta teini-ikäistä lastaan hippiäitinsä (Jane Fonda) luo maalle perhelomalle.

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: Neljä Vietnamin sodan vankileiriltä selvinnyttä veteraania päättää suorittaa viimeisen pakonsa - vanhainkodista. Pakosuunnitelman työstäminen seniilissä porukassa tuo kuitenkin omat haasteensa.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards on onneton nuori mies, joka kärsii vastakaiuttomasta rakkaudesta ja haluaa epätoivoisesti muuttaa elämänsä. Hän solmii sopimuksen paholaisen kanssa, ja tämä lupaa toteuttaa hänen toiveensa – mutta sillä on hintansa.

programme.title: How To Be A Latin Lover
programme.desc: Maximolla on unelma: hän haluaa tulla rikkaaksi tekemättä päivääkään töitä. Hän opettelee viettelemään rikkaita, vanhempia naisia ja päätyy naimisiin reilusti vanhemman naisen kanssa.

programme.title: Fighting Caravans
programme.desc: Clint Belmet (Gary Cooper) is a frontier scout with his hands full in this 1931 Paramount Pictures version of Zane Grey's novel. He's helping guide a wagon train across the country, fighting off various attacks on the way, and falling for his lovely Felice (Lily Damita). Belmet's grizzled companions think he should leave the woman alone, but it gets lonely out on the trail, and Felice's charms are hard to resist. Featuring such notable character actors of the period as Ernest Torrence, Tully Marshall, and Fred Kolher, this vintage Hollywood Western still packs a wallop!

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: The Dude Ranger
programme.desc: Its nothing but action and thrills when an Easterner inherits a cattle ranch and discovers that thousands of cattle have been stolen. Secretly, he signs on as a hired hand at his own ranch to uncover the thief. Once he realizes whats going on, the city boy becomes a hard-riding, avenging son of a six- shooter! Directed by Edward F. Cline from a story by Zane Grey, the film stars George OBrien, Irene Hervey, and LeRoy Mason.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho are falsely accused of robbing a stagecoach. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Two bandits impersonate Cisco and Pancho, sending the two to prison for robbery and murder. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was nominated for a PrimeTime Emmy Award in 1951. It was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho must prove their innocence when they are accused of killing the assistant to the sheriff in Bonanza.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 .This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco tries to help a beautiful woman prove that her brother is innocent after he's arrested for murder.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode first aired in 1950.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark tracks down the James Brothers who seek revenge on the law following the death of their half-brother.This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954. Also, look for legendary tough guy actor lee Van Cleef as Jesse James.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Railroad detective Matt Clark is challenged by a band of freight-car robbers led by Apache chief Geronimo. This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle, plus Chief Yowlachie and Emile Meyer. Directed by William Witney.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as Matt Clark, a railroad detective tasked with the mission to infiltrate the Quantrill gang before the Lawrence Kansas massacre.This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Plus, Bruce Bennet stars as Quantrill, with Steve Darrell as Bloody Bill Anderson.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie investigate a woman named Cattle Kate who seems to be the source of cattle ranches suffering major losses in Sweetwater, Wyoming.This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Cattle Kate: Jean Parker. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye learns that his brother has joined the British army and is now a redcoat. However, when he is murdered by a treacherous Indian companion, Hawkeye seeks revenge. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook come across a group of settlers trapped in the Huron's territory.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye teams up with Benjamin Franklin to take down a tyrant.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingacchook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Townspeople discriminate against a young Indian doctor. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingacchook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook set out to prove the innocence of the Delaware tribe. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper.Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: After leaving his father for dead when they are attacked by Hurons, Tom Morgan flees his village. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.desc: Hawkeye is accused of the crimes committed by Ethan Allan and the Green Mountain boys. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: A town starts to believe they are being cursed by a witch after a series of strange occurences. Hawkeye: John Hart. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: His Wits, Weapons and Women, Turned Defeat Into Victory! A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives! Starring Lance Fuller, Sterling Holloway, Henry Hull, Chill Wills, Cathy Downs, and Jeanne Cagney, plus one of the great B-Western heels, I. Stanford Jolley!

programme.title: Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western about a man avenging the murder of his parents. Other cast members include frequent Wayne sidekick George 'Gabby Hayes', plus Yakima Canutt, Sheila Terry, and Jack Rockwell. This Paul Malvern Production from director Robert N. Bradbury also features Earl Dwire, one of the great B-movie villains, as Zanti, the ruthless bandit who sets the action in motion.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as The Polka Dot Bandit in this B-movie gem. Along the way, Carruthers finds himself in more trouble than he'd ever expected! Written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, the film features George Gabby Hayes, Eleanor Hunt, and many other favorites of the era. Wayne was only 27 at the time of Blue Steel, but was well on his way to becoming The Duke.

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Painted Desert
programme.desc: A mightly melodrama of red-blooded action, William Boyd stars in the Pre-Code western talkie - The Painted Desert (1931). The first sound film for Hollywood heavyweight Clark Gable, The Painted Desert finds Boyd and Gable at odds over the affections of a cowboy's beautiful daughter (Helen Twelvetrees).

programme.title: Courageous Avenger
programme.desc: Gold, gangs, and the heroic fight for life! Johnny Mack Brown (Billy the Kid, Coquette) stars in this western thriller about murders going on in a mining community. Its a story full of twists, where the greed for gold is only surpassed by the struggle for life!

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Mason of the Mounted
programme.desc: Canadian Mountie Mason is sent south of the border to look for a horse thief with only a watch chain for evidence. He befriends young Andy and when Calhoun hits Andy, Mason and Calhoun fight. In the scuffle Calhoun's watch with the missing chain is dislodged. Mason then sets out to bring in Calhoun and his gang.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Feud of the Trail
programme.desc: Feud of the Trail places the dashing Tom Tylerr, a B-Western star (and the original Captain Marvel) in dual roles; as a man seeking justice against a band of outlaws, and the bands vicious gang leader. Capably directed by helmer Robert F. Hill (Flash Gordon, Tarzan the Fearless), and shot at the iconic Lazy A Ranch outside of Los Angeles, the film follows Tom Wade, an honorable man with a face thats nearly identical to nefarious gang leader Jack Granger. Using this to his advantage, Wade exploits his similar looks to impersonate the gangster and infiltrate his band of ruffians.

programme.title: Billy The Kid Returns
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: Oscar winner Michael Curtiz (Casablanca, Mildred Pierce) directed this exciting drama about Army officer Jeb Stuart and the days leading up to the Civil War. Errol Flynn (The Adventures of Robin Hood) stars as Stuart, with Olivia de Havilland as his romantic interest (the seventh of nine times they were paired together by Warner Bros.) The cast includes Ronald Reagan as General George Custer, and Raymond Massey as John Brown, with such familiar faces as Alan Hale and Van Hefflin in supporting roles. Filmed partly in Santa Fe!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: Fast Bullets
programme.desc: Tom Tyler stars in this vintage western from the short-lived Reliable Pictures Company, a group known for low budgets and lots of action. In this feature, Tom reforms a gang member in order to infiltrate a ring of thieves. Rex Lease, Margaret Nearing, and Al Bridge also star.

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Phantom Ranger
programme.desc: Cowboy hero Tim McCoy stars as Tim Hayes, a two-fisted G-Man working for the FBI on a counterfeit money case. The incredibly daring Hayes infiltrates a gang that has kidnapped a Treasury Department engraver. Under the direction of Poverty Row icon Sam Newfield, McCoy turns in another of his legendary slam-bang performances, making Phantom Ranger a perennial favorite of B-Western fans.

programme.title: In Old Cheyenne
programme.desc: Roy Rogers plays a newspaper reporter sent to Cheyenne to investigate a reputed troublemaker. While on the scene, he discovers who the real bad guys are, and sets out to right some wrongs. Also starring Roy's usual sidekick George 'Gabby' Hayes, plus Joan Woodbury, and George Rosener. This Republic Pictures western was helmed by director Joseph Kane (The Undersea Kingdom, Dakota) and features two musical numbers: 'Bonita' and 'Linda Flor'.

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Concerto - OSN Fabio Luisi e Alexander Gadjiev Torino 2022

Gadjiev delivered a masterful performance of Chopin’s Piano Concerto No. 2, while Luisi led a captivating interpretation of Strauss’ Aus Italien.

programme.title: Med Whats On Extraordinary Events
programme.desc: Spring is transforming the Mediterranean into a massive stage for high-tech art and spectacular outdoor events. We begin at the Ta Qali National Park for the Bloom Festival, where wellness and music create a vibrant sanctuary in the heart of Malta. From there, we head into the tunnels and forts of Valletta and Birgu for the Malta Biennale 2026 to discover contemporary installations hidden inside historic sites rarely seen by the public. Our journey takes us to the cliffs of Gozo as giant creative designs fill the sky for the International Kite and Wind Festival before we land in Venice to witness the world class creativity of the 61st International Art Exhibition. This is a look at a region in the middle of a stunning cultural rebirth.

programme.title: Dates that made History
programme.desc: 399 BC: The Trial of Socrates dramatises the famous trial of the Greek philosopher Socrates, who is charged with corrupting the youth and impiety. The episode delves into Socrates' defence, his philosophical ideas, and his unwavering commitment to his principles. It explores the tension between individual thought and the societal norms of ancient Athens. Through this trial, the show examines the impact of Socrates' ideas on Western philosophy and his legacy.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: With its thought-provoking sights, delicious cuisine, and idyllic coastline, it's no wonder Normandy is both a Mecca for history buffs and a popular getaway for Parisians.

programme.title: Mediterranean Kitchen Tunisia
programme.desc: Chef Kurt welcomes Chef Rania to prepare a vibrant Tunisian masterpiece: fluffy, spice-infused couscous served with melt-in-your-mouth tender lamb and slow-simmered vegetables. While the aromatic steam fills the kitchen, the two dive into the bold flavours of North Africa and the personal stories behind Rania’s family recipes. It’s an authentic celebration of heat, heritage, and the comfort of home cooking.

programme.title: Med Nations 08 Egypt
programme.desc: Journey along the northern coast of Egypt, where the Mediterranean meets the land of the pharaohs. From the historic streets and libraries of Alexandria to charming coastal towns and bustling markets, Egypt reveals a unique blend of ancient heritage, vibrant culture, and seaside traditions that continue to shape life along its Mediterranean shores.

They also explore how the changing world of technology, including the opportunities and challenges that AI brings to journalism, broadcasting and the future of media.

programme.title: Twist in the Tail Tiny Home
programme.desc: In the charming town of Equi Terme, nestled in a dramatic valley famous for its thermal baths. The tiny house at the end of the street promised charm, but the tour had a few surprises! With one bedroom upstairs, a kitchenette, a tiny living room, and multiple terraces, it’s perfect for lovers of unspoiled nature or avid climbers, though the spiral staircase might not be for everyone. Stick around as we explore the delightful borgo itself!

programme.title: Acqua da proteggere
programme.desc: With Marco Faimali, director of the CNR's Institute for the Study of Marine Sustainability, we explore the ocean's fragile ecosystem and the need for protection. Anna Pancaldi visits marine protected areas, including the Smart Bay of Santa Teresa and the port of La Spezia, where researchers study alien species. Finally, we learn about the underwater internet, an innovation from Sapienza University of Rome led by Professor Chiara Petrioli and the WSENSE team.

programme.title: il pane, le torte, la pizza
programme.desc: Accompany, contain, support: three key concepts defining Italy's iconic culinary creations—bread, cakes, and pizza. Bread, a fundamental staple, complements dishes while holding symbolic meaning. Savory pies, rooted in medieval tradition, have remained unchanged through centuries. Lastly, pizza, an ancient grain-based dish, achieved global fame after merging with tomatoes in Naples. Massimo Montanari leads us through this rich and flavorful journey.

programme.title: Made in Med: Heritage of Weaving

From the rhythm of the hand loom to the finishing details, discover the patience, imagination, and skill behind her craft.

programme.title: BP Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal 2026
programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally-Raid joined the W2RC calendar in 2024. The competition on Portuguese and Spanish tracks is always unforgettable for both cars and motorcycles. The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. Diversity is the key word for the five days of racing! The bivouac is set up in the heart of the town of Grândola, in the province of Setúbal, 100 kilometers south of Lisbon.

programme.title: Long Distance
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A man is confined to a wheelchair as a result of his wife's actions. His mother moves in with them and constantly reminds the wife that it is her fault and the wife uses every opportunity to escape from the stifling situation. The family is thrown into chaos when a male nurse is hired.

programme.title: Just Too Close
programme.desc: Two cousins find out they are in a relationship with the same guy, and things get even more complicated when one of them becomes pregnant. Will she keep the baby?

programme.title: Jewel
programme.desc: When Tara discovers her fiance has a secret life abroad, she decides to have a family without him by adopting a child, however things get complicated after a chance meeting with a stranger derails her plans.

programme.title: Burning Desire
programme.desc: After getting drunk during a club party with friends, Kay gets entangled in a one-night stand with an older married woman, Mariah, who becomes obsessed with him. Things go awry when Kay comes back home from work one evening and finds Mariah sitting in his living room with his wife, Angela, claiming to be his aunt who just returned from overseas.

programme.title: Miss Perfect
programme.desc: Diana, a very religious woman, is constantly judging the behaviour of everyone around her and pushing her friends away. When a series of coincidences lead others to judge her, she is left re-examining her own actions.

programme.title: The Choice You Made
programme.desc: Jessica’s frustration with her reckless brother Stanley reaches a breaking point when he falls for Jasmine, a fiery young woman with a notorious road rage incident in her past.

programme.title: The Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Alex's bad behaviour is a cause of concern for his parents causing them to take drastic action. They oust him from the family business, giving the reins to his well-behaved sister.

programme.title: Something Strange
programme.desc: Dami and Shalewa’s lives are turned upside down when birthday celebrations turn into a nightmare and Shalewa is assaulted. Dami is pointed as the obvious culprit due to his constant pursuit of Shalewa but are there other people being overlooked?

programme.title: Fashion Insider - Charcoal Shade
programme.desc: Discover new designers, trends, styles, and more at Fashion Insider. Elileojo Achebo provides you with the opportunity to gain firsthand knowledge of the African stylists of the moment.

programme.title: Catching Feelings
programme.desc: Catherine finally has enough of her abusive boyfriend, Hans, and, with the encouragement of her friend and business partner, Brienne, decides to move on. She believes she has met the perfect man online, but all is not as it seems and a setback sends her spiralling.

programme.title: We Did It For Love
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A desperate guy down on his luck, deceitfully takes a loan from a loan shark to secure a future with his soul mate, a decision he soon regrets.

programme.title: You And I S2 - Ep7
programme.desc: Ayo and Uzooma are back, navigating a new chapter of marriage where love, commitment and real-life challenges continue to put their relationship to the test.

programme.title: You And I S2 - Ep8
programme.desc: Ayo and Uzooma are back, navigating a new chapter of marriage where love, commitment and real-life challenges continue to put their relationship to the test.

programme.title: What The Heart Wants
programme.desc: A new chef's arrival disrupts the routine of a celebrity's household, leading to unexpected romantic entanglements and professional challenges. The chef's skills and personality attracts attention, causing complications in the celebrity's personal life.

programme.title: Blurred
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A young couple decide to have an open marriage after being plagued by infidelity for a number of years; putting in place rules of engagement to make sure their relationship stays safe. Things get complicated when one of them falls in love with their new lover and seriously contemplates ending their marriage.

programme.title: Johnnie And Glyde
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Two young psychotic criminal lovers infiltrate the lives of an old married couple for financial gain.

programme.title: Mismatched
programme.desc: A drunken mistake derails Nattan's plans for the perfect life, leading to romantic advances from an unexpected source, a meddling mother and a vengeful ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Mental Health
programme.desc: Andy must face his troubled past when his erratic behaviour starts to affect his current relationship.

programme.title: The Keeper
programme.desc: Armed robbers strike a young man desperate not to do away with his boss’ 50,000 dollars—what he considers a ticket to his elusive good side.

programme.title: The Art Of Love
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Wumi, a dedicated art critic and proprietor of a well-read blog on art, forms a deep connection with one of her blog commenters which leads to a passionate affair. However, as Wumi delves deeper into her lover's world, she uncovers a secret from his past that threatens to shatter the idyllic facade of their romance.

programme.title: Knots That Bind
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Dotun meets Jite when things are going well for him, however, circumstances causes Dotun’s life to take a downturn while things start going well for Jite, which leads her to distance herself from him. Dotun becomes bankrupt and barely surviving, he meets Alero, who does all she can to help him and get his life back together. Jite returns back to his life, leaving Dotun with a difficult choice to make.

programme.title: Perfect Crime
programme.desc: To the outside world, Brenda and Toby seem like a loving couple until little secrets she is keeping from her family start to unravel, leading to fatal consequences.

programme.title: The Guy Next Door
programme.desc: After Leo loses his job, he and his wife, Annie, turn the unwanted obsession of their next-door neighbour, Timothy, who refuses to accept rejection, into a risky source of income.

programme.title: The Hangout S6 Ep5
programme.desc: The Hangout returns for its sixth season with a group of opinionated, social media-savvy millennials who debate controversial topics on love, sex, friendship, and more.

programme.title: Wrongfully Hers
programme.desc: Hijinks follows after Perpetual, pretending to be a sophisticated socialite, befriends Gina who has fallen in love with Esa, not realising he is Perpetual's unappreciated boyfriend.

programme.title: Bad Manner
programme.desc: When Jamie is entrusted with driving his boss’s daughter around and caring for her after she returns to Lagos from abroad, he never expects things to get so complicated.

programme.title: Loving
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Tony’s life falls apart when he loses his job, his marriage and life savings. He tries to kill himself but is rescued in the nick of time. Tony goes to stay with his parents but refuses to leave or pick his life and start all over, until his parents decide enough is enough and intervene.

programme.title: A Fight For Love
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. After Amaka is given six months to live, she is abandoned by her husband. With nothing left to lose, she leaves her home and moves to Lagos, deciding to live her life to the fullest where she falls in love with Onyebuchi. Things come to a head when she realises that she has been lied to by her doctor and her husband comes back into the picture, wanting to fight for his wife.

programme.title: Love Trap
programme.desc: When down-on-her-luck Sophia goes to her friend for help, she is introduced to a lifestyle that gets her into trouble with the authorities causing her to find ways to change her fate.

programme.title: A Wish For Hell
programme.desc: A newly married couple are facing a crisis in their marriage as the wife feels unfufilled and the husband is hiding a big secret that will change everything.

programme.title: The Crush
programme.desc: After a rocky first encounter, Donald finds himself torn between his feelings for Sandra, his sister's friend, and his commitment to his materialistic fiancée, Ivy. As his wedding plans unfold, he struggles to convince his sister to help with the preparations, all while navigating his growing feelings.

programme.title: The Husband Material
programme.desc: Nasir’s presence in Mina’s life is all the push she needs to change her ways, but her worrisome career path makes it difficult for him to take the step.

programme.title: Wicked Agenda

programme.title: Id:A

programme.title: Tulitikkutehtaan tyttö

programme.title: Zombie ja kummitusjuna
programme.desc: Zombie on oman tiensä kulkija, joka ei pysty noudattamaan suomalaisen yhteiskunnan hänelle asettamia normeja. Zombie päättää jättää kaiken ja suunnata ulkomaille - paikkaan jossa kukaan ei odota häneltä mitään. Zombie ja kummitusjuna kuuluu monien mielestä Mika Kaurismäen elokuvien parhaimmistoon.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Valehtelija
programme.desc: Valehtelija on kuvaus nuoresta huulenheittäjästä, joka ei koskaan puhu totta. Aki Kaurismäen esittämä nuori mies kuljeskelee pitkin Helsingin katuja ja koittaa lainata rahaa tutuilta ja tuntemattomilta, milloin milläkin verukkeella.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Pidä huivista kiinni, Tatjana

programme.title: Linan yökirja
programme.desc: Liina Berglund on täysin tavallinen 15 - vuotias tyttö, joka haluaisi olla samanlainen kuin hänen huolettomat ja suositut ystävänsä. Liina on kyllästynyt olemaan näkymätön ja sellainen reppana, joka ei koskaan ole edes suudellut.

programme.title: Call of the Unseen
programme.desc: Nuori taideopiskelija menettää uskonsa luoviin kykyihinsä. Oppilaan vanhahkoa opettajaa kiusaavat synkät mielikuvat, joita hänen kolkot maalauksensa herättävät. Heidän kohtalonsa kietoutuvat yhteen seikkailurikkaalla matkalla, jonka varrella he haluavat löytää itsensä.

programme.title: Original
programme.desc: Henry on elämän kalpea kopio. Nuori pankkivirkailija yrittää niin innokkaasti sopeutua muiden odotuksiin, että hän on jo kauan sitten kadottanut itsensä. Sitten Jon ilmestyy tyhjästä ja houkuttelee Henryn lähtemään mukaan Espanjaan avaamaan aidon bodegan.

programme.title: Van Veeteren - Tapaus G
programme.desc: Van Veeterenin ainoa selvittämättömäksi jäänyt tapaus näkee jälleen päivänvalon kun erään yksityisetsivän tytär tulee tapaamaan häntä. Väkivaltainen murhaaja, joka katosi vuosia sitten jäljettömiin, vaikuttaa palanneen uudella nimellä varustettuna - ja sekaantuneena uuteen murhaan.

programme.title: Id:A
programme.desc: Hän ei tiedä, kuka hän on tai miten hän on päätynyt Ranskaan mukanaan kaksi miljoona euroa käteistä - ja ladattu ase. Mutta ilmiselvää on, että hän on hengenvaarassa. Hänen on otettava kaikki keinot käyttöön, mikäli hän mielii pysyä hengissä riittävän kauan selvittääkseen, kuka hän on.

programme.title: Lindell - Orkesterimonttu - Osa 1
programme.desc: Elämänsä parhaan esityksen jälkeen oopperassa ensiviulisti Siv Ellen Blad murhataan julmasti. Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa nopeasti selville, että hän oli joutunut postiryöstön kohteeksi. Piileekö siinä yhteys?

programme.title: Lindell - Orkesterimonttu - Osa 2
programme.desc: Elämänsä parhaan esityksen jälkeen oopperassa ensiviulisti Siv Ellen Blad murhataan julmasti. Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa nopeasti selville, että hän oli joutunut postiryöstön kohteeksi. Piileekö siinä yhteys?

programme.title: Team Albert
programme.desc: Tee mitä haluat. Lukiolainen Albert ottaa hyvää tarkoittavan neuvon kirjaimellisesti. Yliopistoon meneminen lukion jälkeen ja sen jälkeen toimistotyön saaminen ei yksinkertaisesti ole se, miten hän kuvittelee tulevaisuutensa.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: Helmiä Ja Sikoja
programme.desc: Hirvoset, neljä veljestä ja isäukko, elelevätJoensuun Rantakylässä ja pyörittävätpienimuotoista bisnestä Pimeetä viinaa japikkusuolasta.

programme.title: 6 Juni
programme.desc: Samira on kaunis 24-vuotias nainen. Hänen perheensä on luvannut hänet vaimoksi miehelle, jota hän ei rakasta. Jos Samira ei suostu avioliittoon, häntä uhkaa kunniamurha.

programme.title: Pidä huivista kiinni, Tatjana
programme.desc: Koskenkorvaa litkivä automekaanikko Reino (Matti Pellonpää) ja kahvista riippuvainen peräkamarin poika Valto (Mato Valtonen) lähtevät viettämään viikonloppua ja kohtaavat matkalla virolaisen Tatjanan (Kati Outinen) ja venäläisen Klavdian (Kirsi Tykkyläinen).

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Laittomat katuajot, alkoholi ja vauhdikkaat suhteet pitävät asiat mielenkiintoisina levottomille ja adrenaliinia janoaville kaveruksille. Yhdistelmä osoittautuu kuitenkin hengenvaaralliseksi, kun Nikolaj ja hänen paras ystävänsä Martin aiheuttavat nuoren tytön kuoleman katuajoissa.

programme.title: Team Albert
programme.desc: Tee mitä haluat. Lukiolainen Albert ottaa hyvää tarkoittavan neuvon kirjaimellisesti. Yliopistoon meneminen lukion jälkeen ja sen jälkeen toimistotyön saaminen ei yksinkertaisesti ole se, miten hän kuvittelee tulevaisuutensa.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Linan yökirja
programme.desc: Liina Berglund on täysin tavallinen 15 - vuotias tyttö, joka haluaisi olla samanlainen kuin hänen huolettomat ja suositut ystävänsä. Liina on kyllästynyt olemaan näkymätön ja sellainen reppana, joka ei koskaan ole edes suudellut.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: Rebounce
programme.desc: Rebounce on tanskalainen draama teini-ikäisestä Louisesta, joka asuu isovanhempiensa luona, koska hänen äitinsä on vankilassa. Kun äiti yllättäen vapautuu, alkaa Louise salaa pitää yhteyttä äitiinsä ja ihannoida tätä sokeasti.

programme.title: Historiaa Tehdään Öisin
programme.desc: Harry on CIA-agentti, joka toimii peitetehtävissä helsinkiläisen Moving Planet -jazzklubin omistajana. Nuori SVR-agentti Natasha asuu myös Helsingissä – hänen tehtävänä on vakoilla Harrya.

programme.title: Garden Lane
programme.desc: Kun Eric ja Elin tapaavat jälleen aikuisina hautajaisissa, he kokevat uudelleen synkän maagisen kesän, jolloin he tapasivat ensimmäisen kerran. He olivat pelkkiä lapsia, mutta heidän vanhempansa Linda ja Peter olivat ongelmakäyttäjiä.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: John Hron
programme.desc: Länsi-Ruotsi, kesä 1995. Neo-natiivien väkivaltaisuudet horjuvat koko maassa. Elokuva on todellinen tarina 14-vuotiaasta kavereista Kungälvin pienestä yhteisökoodista.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Pidä huivista kiinni, Tatjana
programme.desc: Koskenkorvaa litkivä automekaanikko Reino (Matti Pellonpää) ja kahvista riippuvainen peräkamarin poika Valto (Mato Valtonen) lähtevät viettämään viikonloppua ja kohtaavat matkalla virolaisen Tatjanan (Kati Outinen) ja venäläisen Klavdian (Kirsi Tykkyläinen).

programme.title: Münsterin juttu
programme.desc: Varakas viininmaahantuoja löydetään brutaalisti murhattuna voimakkaan iskun jälkeen päähän. Münster saa tapauksen tutkittavakseen.

programme.title: Over The Edge
programme.desc: David ja Freja ovat mielettömän rakastuneita ja muuttavat unelmataloonsa Mønin saarelle. Pian idylli särkyy selittämättömän itsemurhan jälkeen. David päättää selvittää mysteerin, mutta mitä lähemmäs totuutta hän pääsee, sitä kauemmas hän etääntyy Frejasta.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Zombie ja kummitusjuna
programme.desc: Zombie on oman tiensä kulkija, joka ei pysty noudattamaan suomalaisen yhteiskunnan hänelle asettamia normeja. Zombie päättää jättää kaiken ja suunnata ulkomaille - paikkaan jossa kukaan ei odota häneltä mitään. Zombie ja kummitusjuna kuuluu monien mielestä Mika Kaurismäen elokuvien parhaimmistoon.

programme.title: The Best Man

programme.title: The Wedding, Pt. 2

programme.title: Diamond In The Rough
programme.desc: Freddie the Fox Brander is retired, but thirty years ago he was the world's greatest thief. Still dignified and charming as in days of old, he is disturbed in his retirement by two former crime partners who are sure that Freddie has the famous Light of Arabia diamond. They are preparing to torture him into revealing where it is, but Freddie escapes and goes straight to Charlie's Angels for help. He knows that the diamond is in the possession of oil sheik Faris Salim, who keeps it in his extremely well-guarded Caribbean estate. Freddie's plan is for the Angels to assist him in stealing the diamond once again, so that he can return it to the museum, and retire from crime forever. The Angels eagerly accept the job, and assume new identities for the Caribbean caper. Freddie and Sabrina become Lord and Lady Brander, with Bosley as their butler and Kelly as their private secretary. Kris pretends to be a racing car enthusiast in order to win the attention of Ali, Salim's mechanic-minded son. The idea is for everyone to get invited to Salim's birthday party, and once in the house, learn where the diamond is kept so Freddie can decide how to steal it. Since Salim has an affinity for nobility, invitations are not difficult to obtain. At the party, while Sabrina snaps pictures from a secret camera planted in her jeweled pin, Salim decides to show off his prize diamond, which is, indeed, guarded securely. the entire floor is electrified, ands as deadly snake hovers over the jewel. Sabrina pretends to 'faint' upon seeing the snake, and Kelly makes a wax impression of the lock to the only window in the room. This, with the secret photos, provides Freddie with all he needs to engineer the theft. A little help from Ali is needed at last minute -- he never did like his father very much. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones

programme.title: Angels In The Backfield
programme.desc: The Angels have never played football before, but that changes quickly when Amy Jarvis and her father Dan come to them for help. The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's win-at-any-cost attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosle

programme.title: The Sandcastle Murders
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris stalk the sands of Malibu Beach to track down the surfside killer of several young women in Sandcastles Murders. Police have virtually no leads in their investigation of the Sandcastle Murders. When one of the victims turns out to be a personal friend of Kris, boss Charlie give the girls permission to handle their own investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Magic Fire
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper, guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on Charlie's Angels. The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious demonstration of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.
